shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up the south wall of the hilltop hall and over its roof to reveal the lower town and the River Prosper below; stay 6 m off the wall and 5 m above the roof.
shots.notes: Film-opening rise: lens starts 1.9 m above the hilltop grass beside the Life Stone, staring up the 10 m south wall of the brick hilltop hall (S121, top z 104.2), climbs 20.6 m straight up the face and over the roofline while pitching from +15 to -9 deg, revealing the lower-town rooftops and the River Prosper 270 m north (subject hidden for the first ~9.75 s by design, clear from t=10). Morning sun from the east side-lights the hall. Clearance: wall 13 m ahead at the start, 12.4 m at the end, end z 116.5 = 12.3 m above the roof; nearest prop a candelabra 4.5 m; vmax 2.6 m/s. JEV candidate if the film's hero budget allows.

shots.standingOrder: Look up at the Holtburg Life Stone from just above the grass with the morning sky behind it; creep 1 m closer and keep 2 m from the crystal.
shots.notes: Life Stone detail: lens 0.7 m above the hilltop grass ESE of the crystal (bearing 120, sun behind the camera), looking up at the 3.6 m sparkling stone against the morning sky and creeping 1 m closer. Alcott the greeter stands 3 m NE of the stone, off-axis. Clearance: 4 m from the stone centre (>= 2.2 m from its 3 m-wide setup bounds), no static within 4 m (WBT query-radius 0 hits).

shots.standingOrder: Glide east along the timbered fronts of the lower-town halls at walking pace, 9 m off the walls and 3 m up, past the forges and lanterns; nothing may cross between lens and wall.
shots.notes: The town's one facade pan (Aluvian timber-and-stone halls): glides 34 m east along the south fronts of S118, S114 and S117 on the lower terrace, 7.5-9 m off the walls and 2.6-3.8 m above the sloping street, ending on the brass lanterns and the Fletching Forge glow. Morning sun rakes the facades from the right. Clearance: nearest wall 7.5 m, no static/scenery within 4 m of the line (query-radius 0 hits), vmax 4.5 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Skim south 4 m above the River Prosper toward Holtburg on its hill; stay over open water and 30 m from the banks.
shots.notes: Water: skims south 4 m above the running water of the River Prosper (terrain type WaterRunning, z 28) for 80 m with Holtburg's lower terrace and hilltop roofs rising ahead (the roofs peek over the terrace edge, the town on its hill as in the lore). Path given explicitly (32556,34935)->(32556,34855); whole path over water, banks and trees >= 31.5 m away; vmax 7.3 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 30 m above the hilltop square and turn slowly clockwise from the river round over the Tiofor woods and the eastern towers; hold height, no drift.
shots.notes: Closing panorama: hovers 30 m above the hilltop square (z 124, 17 m above the tallest hilltop roof 106.7) and turns 300 deg clockwise from the river north through the eastern spire towers, the southern woods and back west; clouds on. Clearance 19.8 m to the nearest roof; no translation.

shots.standingOrder: Drift slowly in over the northern road and look down into the forest bowl of Glenden Wood; stay 8 m above every tree top.
shots.notes: Establishing: from 46 m above the north road (z 105) the camera drifts 8 deg and pushes 10 % toward the town, looking down into the forest bowl of Glenden Wood (z 50) ringed by 25-60 m trees, the giant tree and the cottages in the clearing. Noon light from high east. Clearance: 24.6 m to the nearest crown, >= 18 m above every tree top in view; line of sight to the town centre clear in all samples.

shots.standingOrder: Walk east along the forest road into Glenden Wood at an easy pace with the Life Stone and the giant trees ahead; keep to the road, 4 m from every trunk.
shots.notes: POV walk-in: eye height 1.66 m on the west forest road (z 50, flat), walking 22 m east at an easy pace with a light step bob; the Life Stone sparkles right of centre (NDC x 0.33->0.60) and the giant tree's canopy fills the upper frame (NDC y 0.5->0.8); foliage pollen/leaves catch the noon light. Clearance: passes 2.7 m from a 2.3 m bush and >= 4.6 m from every trunk; query-radius 4 m = 0 statics.

shots.standingOrder: Start on the forest canopy above the cottages and tilt down slowly onto the blue swirl of the Town Network portal; hold position 10 m from the portal.
shots.notes: Particle detail: locked position 14 m east of the Town Network portal (open lawn, sun behind), tilting from 42 deg above the portal (the canopy of a 33 m tree and the cottage roofs against the sky) down onto the blue swirl. Clearance: 3.2 m from a signpost that stays out of frame (60 deg off-axis), no other static within 4 m. Note: the opt-in retail scenery bake would place a pine at this spot; the default bake (what renders) is clear.

shots.standingOrder: Spiral slowly up and around the giant tree of Glenden Wood with the town bowl behind it; stay 8 m above every tree top and 20 m from the giant crown.
shots.notes: Hero aerial: helix 0.28 turn clockwise around the 58 m giant tree from SW to N, radius 36->50 m, rising z 100->132, the town clearing beside it. Clearance: >= 14 m above the default-bake pine tops (<= 86), 19.7 m to the nearest crown, 30+ m from the giant crown; vmax 8.3 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down on the town square and rise vertically out of the forest bowl while turning slowly; stay 15 m from every crown.
shots.notes: Closing top-down: straight down on the town square at noon (short shadows), rising 16->82 m above it while turning 60 deg; roofs, wells, the siege tent and canopy rings become a pattern. Clearance: 17 m horizontally from the nearest crown (top 83) at the lowest point; vmax 7.4 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Start looking straight down at the sunlit bay, then tilt up while drifting in to reveal Cragstone's terraces climbing to the windmill; hold 55 m above the water.
shots.notes: Water opener: starts 58 m above Victory Bay (shallow sea, z 2) looking almost straight down at the water (-80 deg), then tilts up to -5 deg while drifting 10 m in, revealing the sunlit terraces of Cragstone climbing from the shore ridge to the windmill on the skyline (morning sun behind the camera). Nothing within 60 m.

shots.standingOrder: Look over Thorsten Cragstone's bronze shoulder from his plinth down at the swirling Town Network portal in the square; stay 1 m off the statue.
shots.notes: Landmark: over the bronze shoulder of the Statue of Thorsten Cragstone on his 6.8 m plinth, looking down onto the swirling Town Network portal in the square 26 m away (portal NDC 0.32,-0.15; statue head NDC -0.24,0.20). Camera 2.1 m behind and 0.9 m right of the statue's base centre, 2.1 m above the plinth top (human setup 0x02000001 is 1.82 m; robust to a scaled statue). query-radius 4 m hits only the plinth (by design).

shots.standingOrder: Jib up from the grass in front of the windmill, rising past its turning sails while the arm swings left; stay 14 m from the sails.
shots.notes: Windmill crane: jib rises 14 m from 5 m above the plateau in front of the windmill (24 m south of its turning sails) to above the hub while the arm swings 30 deg; sails stay centred. Side light from the east. Clearance: 19.8 m from the sail disc (blade box), terrain z 67.5-68.7 under the arc.

shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up from the statue of Thorsten Cragstone over the rooftops to the harbour cliff in one smooth line; stay 6 m above every roof.
shots.notes: Closing dronie: pulls back and up from the statue (start 12 m, z 49) to 92 m away (z 84) toward the harbour cliff, over the cottage roofs (S74 top 42.2: >= 6.8 m above, 8.8 m min distance). vmax 9.1 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Lock off 10 m above the harbour cliff looking north-north-east over Victory Harbor while clouds race across the bay; do not move and keep 11 m from the cliff-top trees.
shots.notes: Time-lapse: locked off 10 m above the harbour cliff looking NNE over Victory Harbor; rate 0.01 game-days per film second (sun climbs from 0.42 to 0.54, always up) so the clouds race over the bay. Nearest scenery 11.5 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hang straight above the walled square of Arwic and rotate slowly so its walls, towers and courtyards turn like a map; hold height 30 m above the central tower.
shots.notes: Map shot: hangs 105 m above the walled square (z 147, 74 m above the central tower) looking straight down and rotating 45 deg; the 120 x 86 m wall ring, four corner towers, two spired gates, the inner cross-wall and the plaza fit the frame (corner towers at NDC +/-0.7). Late-afternoon sun from the west adds long tower shadows.

shots.standingOrder: Truck south along the sunlit west wall of Arwic past the gate and its spired gatehouses, 13 m off the stone and 2.5 m up; nothing may come between lens and wall.
shots.notes: The town's facade pan (fortress walls): trucks 32 m south along the sunlit west wall at 2.2 m above the grass, 11-13 m off the stone, past the spired gatehouses and through the axis of the ruined pillar avenue (pillars 7.6 m from the lens). Sun at the camera's back fully lights the wall. Clearance: nearest pillar 7.6 m, wall 11 m, query-radius 4 m = 0 statics; vmax 4.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Fly fast and level east along the north side of the walls, whipping past the north-west corner tower 12 m off its stones; climb rather than swerve if anything comes within 6 m.
shots.notes: Energetic fly-by: 10 m/s level pass east along the outside of the north wall, 13 m above the grass, whipping past the NW corner tower at 12 m offset (peak yaw ~0.8 rad/s). Clearance: 17 m to the tower box, nothing else within 28 m.

shots.standingOrder: Look down the plaza from above the Life Stone onto the swirling Town Network portal and the silver fountain beside the central tower, easing 3 m closer; stay 5 m above the roofs.
shots.notes: Particle + water detail: high angle (34 deg) from above the Life Stone looking down the plaza onto the swirling Town Network portal (NDC 0.03,-0.5) with the silver fountain just beyond it (NDC -0.04,0.09) and the central tower's foot at left, easing 3 m closer. Camera 16-18 m above the plaza, 9 m from the nearest roof edge (S68 top 54.5).

shots.standingOrder: Fly straight back from the central tower over the south wall while zooming in so the tower holds its size and the hills swell behind it; stay 12 m above the walls.
shots.notes: Vertigo closer: flies straight back from the central tower (Aun Laokhe's tower, top 72.9) 45->120 m SSW at 26 m above the plain while zooming 55->23 deg so the tower holds its size and the Lost Wish hills swell behind it. Clearance: 11 m above the south gatehouse spire (top 57.1), 14 m above the southern pillar avenue; vmax 7.9 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Fly in level from the shallow sea toward the Eastham shore with the windmill dead ahead and the town beyond; hold 20 m above the water.
shots.notes: Water opener: level 22 m above the shallow sea NE of town, flying 98 m SW toward the coast with the windmill dead ahead (NDC 0.04,0.34) and Eastham's roofs beyond; morning sun behind the camera lights the shore. All over water/beach (terrain types WaterShallowSea and SandGrey), nothing within 28 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold a locked-off frame 1.8 m above the meadow 52 m south-south-east of the windmill, its sails turning and the Life Stone and portal glowing at its foot; do not move, nothing within 6 m.
shots.notes: Locked-off static (motion lives inside the frame): the windmill's east-facing sails turn against the morning sky, Asheron's Island portal swirls at its foot (NDC -0.05,-0.33) and the Life Stone sparkles at left (NDC -0.76,-0.33). Camera 52 m SSE at 1.8 m above the meadow. Clearance 12.4 m (default bake) and 6.5 m (opt-in retail bake); query-radius 4 m = 0.

shots.standingOrder: Stand 2.3 m above the shore road, hold on the windmill, then whip 178 degrees right onto the rooftops of Eastham 158 m west and hold; the lens never moves and nothing comes within 20 m.
shots.notes: Whip-pan: from the shore road (2.3 m up) the frame holds the windmill silhouetted against the low eastern sun, then whips 178 deg right in 0.3 s at 45 % onto the sunlit rooftops of Eastham 158 m west and holds. No obstacle within 22 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold behind the Banderling statue's plinth with the Town Network portal hidden, then truck right until its blue swirl and the square open up beyond; stay 5 m from the plinth.
shots.notes: Reveal: starts 12 m behind the Banderling statue's 6.8 m plinth with the Town Network portal 44 m beyond completely hidden (25/53 samples blocked by design), holds, then trucks 12 m right until the blue swirl, the well and the square open up. Clearance: 3.5 m from the well (2.7 m-tall setup), 5 m from the nearest NPC, >= 6.8 m from the plinth; vmax 3.1 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit slowly high around the Eastham square while the clouds race and the morning light swings across the roofs; keep 15 m above every roof and tree.
shots.notes: Hyperlapse closer: 0.22 turn counter-clockwise around the town square at radius 68 m, 34 m up (>= 21 m above every roof), while the sky clock runs 110x (0.23 game-day: sun 0.30 -> 0.53, always up) so clouds race and the light swings across the roofs. vmax 5.9 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Descend in a wide slow spiral over the plain toward the walled fortress of Dryreach with its four spired towers in the golden light; stay 10 m above the spire tips.
shots.notes: Arrival: wide counter-clockwise spiral descent from 80 m to 40 m above the plain (radius 140->96 m) toward the fortress, its four 31 m spire towers and spiked palisade glowing in the low golden sun from behind the camera. Clearance: 31 m to the nearest tower, >= 9 m above the spire tips at the end; vmax 10.6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Glide south along the sunlit west palisade of Dryreach past its gate and spiked stakes, 13 m off the wall and 2.5 m up; nothing may come between lens and wall.
shots.notes: The town's facade pan (fortress wall): glides 32 m south along the west palisade and gatehouse, 13 m off the stone and 2.5 m above the flat plain, the golden western sun at the camera's back lighting the wall, its wooden stakes and the gate. Clearance: 11.3 m to the wall, query-radius 4 m = 0, nearest tree 19 m; vmax 4.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Pass straight over the Dryreach courtyard from east to west 30 m up, keeping the well in frame through vertical as the golden light rakes the walls; stay 12 m above every roof and spire.
shots.notes: Pass-over: straight east-to-west pass 30 m above the courtyard (z 48), the gimbal yaw-slewing through vertical over the well with the cottages, portal and spired corners rotating beneath. Clearance 19.8 m to the nearest roof, tower tips 48.8 never closer than 30 m horizontally; 6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up outside the north gate until the lens clears the palisade stakes and looks down on the blue Town Network portal in the courtyard; stay 12 m from the wall.
shots.notes: Particle reveal: pedestal rises 12 m outside the north gate (40 m from the portal): first the gate and stakes fill the frame, then the lens clears the palisade (top ~25) and looks down on the blue Town Network portal in the NW courtyard (blocked 27/49 samples by design, clear from t~6.7). Clearance: 11.7 m to the nearest bush, 12.5 m to the NW tower; vmax 1.6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Cross the north-west spire 6 m above its tip, then dive straight down its north face 5 m off the stone and pull out low over the plain heading north; never closer than 3 m to the tower or trees.
shots.notes: Hero FPV dive (JEV): crosses the NW spire tower level at z 56 (7 m above its tip), crests and dives at -78 deg down the north face 5 m off the stone, pulls out 3 m above the plain and races 40 m north. Clearance: >= 4.6 m from the tower box at the closest, trees >= 19 m; fpv preset, vmax 11.7 m/s (cap 25).

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down from high over the jungle mesa onto the portal clearing; stay 5 m above every roof, deck and canopy; foliage may be faded, never a trunk.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING. Opens 60 m above the jungle south of the mesa looking north over the ring of tusker stilt halls and treehouse decks, then corkscrews counter-clockwise (0.22 rev) down to 22 m over the clearing, ending east of the swirling Town Network portal looking west across the rope walkways to the giant-tree platforms and the lowland jungle beyond; morning sun from the east lights every deck. Verified offline (real technique code, WBT terrain, 0.05 s samples): camera z 118 -> 80, AGL 60.6 -> 22.0 (WBT get-height start 57.35 / end 58.0), >= 12.1 m from every static (rope bridge 0x02000E58 at the end), >= 17 m from default-bake trees; the retail-bake-only jungle tree 0x020007D9 (top 75) would sit 5.1 m below the last frame. Roof tops 72.1 -> camera 7.9 m above them at the end. vmax 9.5 m/s (cinema preset).

shots.standingOrder: Slide north at deck height along the two treehouse platforms and their rope walkway, 17 m off the deck edge; stop before the walkway to the stilt house; never closer than 4 m to a bridge or tree.
shots.notes: FACADE PAN (1 of 2 in this batch): Tumerok/tusker treehouse architecture. Slides 40 m north at deck height (z 66, 2.5 m above the decks) along x 47345, 17 m off the deck edges of the Jeweler's and Grocer's treehouse platforms (24 m square decks around giant trees, z 63.45) and the rope walkway between them, a 30% counter-pan holding the pair while the near jungle trees and the clearing slide past; sun behind the camera. Stops at y 25025, 16 m short of the walkway from the Grocer's deck to the stilt hall (z 62.5-67.6). Verified: AGL 14.4 -> 9.7 over falling ground (WBT 51.58 -> 56.25), >= 7.0 m from every static (the 6 m tree 0x020007BF top 63.9, 2 m below the lens), >= 25 m from default and retail scenery. vmax 5.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Hold low beside the tiki torch with its flame soft at frame right, then pull focus across the clearing to the swirling portal; keep 3 m from the torch and 4 m from the stilt house.
shots.notes: FX: FLAME + PORTAL. Locked low beside the tiki torch 0x02000AB9 at (47397.6, 24989.3) whose flame (0x020005B3 flame-tongue + firelight, catalog 0x32000640/0x32000829) burns soft and out of focus 3.4 m away at upper frame right; at 45% the focus pulls 43 m across the clearing to the purple Town Network swirl on its glowing blue stone base (47377.3, 25023.4), the green-roofed stilt hall and treehouse decks behind it, front-lit by the morning sun behind the camera. Verified: camera (47398.7, 24986.2, 59.9), ground 57.89 (WBT), AGL 2.0; nearest static the flame emitter 2.7 m (the torch pole 3.4 m), the nearest bamboo stilt of stilt hall H3 5.3 m east; default-bake trees >= 10.3 m and none on the sight line; with the opt-in retail bake a 30 m jungle tree (0x020007D4) would stand in front of the portal. DoF look: focusRange 3, bokeh 2.

shots.standingOrder: Look down on the Grocer's treehouse deck from the south-east and creep in; stay 6 m above the rope walkway and 5 m from the canopy.
shots.notes: LANDMARK DETAIL. High angle (32 deg) from the south-east onto the Grocer's treehouse deck (47316, 25048, 63.45): market tables of apples, fruit and fish, barrels, the rope walkway leaving east, the giant tree's canopy through the deck; a 4 m creep-in. Verified: camera (47334.1, 25035.4, 78.7) -> (47331.3, 25037.3, 76.6), AGL 21.9 -> 19.9, 9.7 m from the tree canopy 0x020007D4, 11 m above and 6 m south of the rope bridge, scenery >= 36 m.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 70 m from 5 m above the clearing floor past the treehouse deck and canopy into open sky, the jungle and sea revealed west; climb only, keep 8 m from trees and 20 m from the platform.
shots.notes: CLOSING / TRANSITION. Boom straight up 70 m from the clearing floor (x 47348) with a level gimbal looking west: starts below the level of the Jeweler's treehouse deck, looking at its underside and the giant trunk, rises through deck and canopy level and keeps climbing until the jungle plain 45 m below the mesa and the distant western sea fill the frame (horizon dropping), front-lit by the morning sun. Verified: z 58 -> 128 (ground 53.0 WBT, AGL 5 -> 75), nearest static the 6 m tree 0x020007BF 8.3 m (top 61, passed by 3 s), the platform deck edge 20 m; scenery >= 25 m. vmax 7.9 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up from just above Lake Blessed while keeping the bridge in the river neck centred; stay over open water, 4 m above the surface at the start.
shots.notes: [rw-lake-boom | establishing, optional] Opener over Lake Blessed: the drone hangs 4 m above the open lake 110 m north of the bridge (38610.2, 27169.8) and rises straight up from z 8 to z 52 while the gimbal tilts from +4 to -18 deg on the span, so the narrow River Prosper gorge, the stone arch and both cliff-top halves of Rithwic (chimney smoke on the smithy and East Rithwic roofs, torch posts at both bridge heads) unfold below; afternoon sun rakes in from the right (west) and lights the east cliff and Archmage's quarter. Clearance verified: WBT get-height 4.0 (water) under the camera, nearest object a fishing-hole spawn 11.3 m away, nothing overhead; the tallest roofs (z 34.7) are >100 m away.

shots.standingOrder: Hold low on the town square with the street torch flame sharp at frame right, then pull focus to the purple Town Network portal swirl; stay 4 m from the torch.
shots.notes: [rw-portal-rackfocus | flame + portal FX] Locked low frame on the town square: camera (38468.9, 27007.7, z 24.85, 2.85 m AGL) 18 m ENE of the Portal to Town Network, almost face-on to its purple 7 m vortex (swirl disc faces heading 75 deg, camera at 67 deg) inside its glowing stone ring (0x020019E3); the square's street torch (0x020005D8, flame tongue at 38464.9, 27007.4, z 24.15) burns 4.0 m from the lens at frame right (~18 deg right, 10 deg low) in sharp focus, then focus pulls (at 45%, 2 s) to the portal, with the statue column and Collector behind in warm backlight. Clearance verified: torch post 3.3 m, flame 4.0 m, camera outside the 8.7 m faint-glow halo, LOS to the portal clear (only its own frame), WBT ground 22.0.

shots.standingOrder: Skim north up the river 5 m above the water, slow under the bridge arch on the centre line, then climb out over Lake Blessed; never closer than 1 m to deck, water or banks.
shots.notes: [rw-under-bridge | HERO, JEV] The drone skims north up the River Prosper gorge 5 m above the water at 10 m/s, starting 45 m south of the bridge between the two 18 m cliffs, eases to 4.6 m/s as it threads the centre of the arch (gap at t 6.35 s), then accelerates and climbs from z 10.5 to z 21 as the gorge opens onto Lake Blessed; tilt -4 keeps the water rushing below on the approach and lifts the horizon into open sky and clouds on the exit. Bridge geometry (obj-export of the four GfxObjs, LandBlockInfo buildings without cells): deck 0x01000D6F/0x01000D70 at x 38592-38640, y 27055-27065 (10 m wide), soffit 15.95 m at the abutment joints rising to 18.95 m at the crown x 38616, walkway 24.95-25.95, parapet top 26.95; abutments 0x01000D72/0x01000D71 with sloping soffits down to z 10.55 where they meet the banks at x 38583.2 / 38648.8 (WBT get-height 10.6 there); water z 4.0 from x 38592 to 38640 (WBT, terrain WaterRunning/mud). Verified on the dry-built trajectory: under the deck the camera is 9.1 m below the soffit and 5.5 m above the water, 22 m from the nearest abutment; nearest scenery 5.9 m (bank tree at the south mouth), fishing-hole spawns >= 3.2 m below; peak speed 10.2 m/s (cinema cap 12), no overspeed.

shots.standingOrder: Slide slowly across the river pool south of the bridge, 11 m above the water, keeping the whole span between the cliffs in frame; stay 5 m above the bank trees.
shots.notes: [rw-bridge-slide | companion of the hero] Broadside of the Rithwic bridge from over the river pool SSE of it: 11 m above the water (z 15) the drone slides 22 m west at 72 m from the span with a 30% counter-pan, so the whole crossing (four stone pieces, 96 m incl. abutments, deck soffit 16-19 m, parapet 27 m) spans the 18 m deep gorge between the two cliff-top halves of town; torch posts burn at both bridge heads, chimney smoke drifts over the smithy, a big bankside tree frames the left edge and Lake Blessed glints through the arch. Side light from the west. Clearance verified: water under the camera all the way (WBT get-height 4.0), nearest object a 9 m bank tree 5.9 m away (camera above its crown), LOS to the span >= 5.4 m clear.

shots.standingOrder: Arc slowly around the ruined Greenspire portal with its lightning arcs centred, 14 m out and 4.5 m up; keep 6 m from the arcs and 4 m from the pines.
shots.notes: [rw-ruin-lightning | lightning/particle FX, optional] East Rithwic's ruined arrival point beside the Life Stone: the shattered Destroyed Portal to Greenspire (crystal ruin 0x02000B61, 6 m wide) wreathed in a standing tesla cluster (3x setup 0x02000B6F, emitter 0x32000648, bolts 0.2-4.3 m crackling at z 25.6) plus arc fountains at its base (0x020007C5). Slow ccw arc at 14 m radius and z 27 (5 m AGL) from bearing 250 to 190 deg, looking ENE then N so the dark giant pine behind (0x02000258) makes the white-blue arcs pop while the sun lights the crystals from behind the camera. Clearance verified: flat plateau z 22 (WBT), >= 9.8 m from any shipped-bake scenery, >= 9 m from the arc tips; with ?sceneryBake=retail a 3.8 m bush comes within 1.9 m, so keep the default bake (or raise heightAGL to 6).

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up the face of the bowyer's house past its burning door torch and over the roofline to reveal Lytelthorpe Keep on its hill; stay 6 m off the facade and 5 m above the roof.
shots.notes: [lyt-010] Opener. Starts at eye level in the main street facing the Bowyer/Tailor house (0x0100082E, top z 52.5) whose door torch (0x020005D8, flame + warm glow 0x32000829) burns lower-right of frame (ndc 0.44,-0.92), rises 17.5 m past the facade and over the roofline; the keep is hidden by the house for the first ~6.5 s (LOS blocked 26/49 samples) and is revealed centred with both spire towers against the clouds. Verified: start (36755.1,24622.6,41.3) ground 39.5 (WBT get-height 39.57); facade 6.3-7.8 m away during the rise, end 6.3 m above the roof plane and 8.4 m off the face; nearest scenery 4.3 m (shrub 0x020002F2 top 42.7) and 4.4 m (tree 0x02000246 crown 36-45, behind camera); query-radius 6 m = 0 statics; vmax 2.3 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit the keep at a steady 52 m radius, 36 m above the courtyard; keep the keep and both spire towers in frame and stay outside the tower spires.
shots.notes: [lyt-020] Grand aerial: 0.29-rev counter-clockwise orbit from WSW (sun behind the camera, keep front-lit) round to SSE (raking side light), 52 m radius, z 90 = 5.2 m above the keep/tower spire tips (z 84.75) and 31 m above the curtain walls; whole square fortress, its three pyramid-roofed towers, the wooded courtyard and the town below. Verified: AGL 36.5-44 over terrain 45.8-53.3; nearest object 28.6 m (NW tower AABB); no scenery within 32 m; vmax 6.8 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Cross the fortress northward 38 m above the courtyard with the gimbal tracking straight down past the keep's spire roof; climb rather than swerve if any spire comes within 6 m.
shots.notes: [lyt-050] Flagship crossing: level northward pass at z 92 (38 m above the courtyard), gimbal tracks the keep down through nadir (yaw-slew <=45 deg/s) and back up behind - curtain walls, courtyard trees, the gate and the two north spire towers wheel through frame.
